Usage: agentcage scaffold [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Create and manage custom scaffolds.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  create  Create a new user scaffold.
  delete  Delete a user scaffold.
  edit    Open a user scaffold in $EDITOR.
  export  Export a scaffold to a directory.
  list    List all available scaffolds.
  show    Show details of a scaffold.
